Name: Jair, Son of Manasseh
Summary: Jair, son of Manasseh, captured the towns of Argob east of the Jordan and called them Havoth-jair, the towns of Jair.
KeyStory: Jair took the small towns of Argob and gave them his own name, which they kept for generations.
LifeLesson: What God gives, a faithful man puts his name to and keeps.
